summary: GLM DSA prefill with decode context parallelism gathers the index keys once per request inside the reserved workspace
compatibility: Opt-in: set VLLM_DCP_INDEXER_KEY_GATHER=1 for GLM DSA launches with DCP > 1. Without it the DSA indexer keeps sharded scoring and candidate merging; captured execution and decode rows always do.
details: This imports the index-key gather that vllm-998-ckv-selection excluded, with the buffers of vllm-1006: the exchanged key shards, the gathered keys, the selection scratch, the scores and the restored selection are views of one workspace borrow, reserved before KV-cache sizing for max_model_len and the largest prefill step and shared with the CKV gather receive buffer. A request beyond the reservation fails on the locked workspace instead of allocating.

Each DCP rank contributes its key shard once per indexer layer; the tensor-parallel ranks score disjoint row slices against the whole context and all-gather only the selected indices, instead of exchanging every shard's top-k candidates and scores for every row. Shard scores are allocated only for the decode rows that keep candidate merging.

GLM-5.3-NVFP4-CSF at TP8 DCP2 (MTP3) with the CKV gather, prefill tok/s at 8K / 32K / 128K: 7,397 / 7,068 / 6,704 with candidate merging -> 7,815 / 7,515 / 7,488. With the KV cache profiled at 92% GPU memory (1,217,792 tokens), candidate merging ran out of memory in its 256 MiB candidate all-gather on the first 8K prompt, while the key gather served a 1,048,448-token prompt, 64 concurrent 8K prompts and 4 minutes of 1K-96K prompts with at least 607 MiB free per GPU.
